notes.title: Welcome to Earthlings!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to All Earthlings![/b]

After 10 months of hard work, we’re finally here with Earthlings officially announced! If you’re reading this, we couldn’t be happier. Thank you for taking the time to explore our charming, feel-good strategy game where creating art takes center stage and aliens complicate your life.

If you haven’t already, be sure to check out our announcement trailer! It sets the tone and gives you a first glimpse at the gameplay.

[previewyoutube=U0DZ998tXUk;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re thrilled to have our first trailer out in the world. While we’ve got a solid vision of what Earthlings will become, there’s still plenty to build so stay tuned!

If you like what you see, please consider wishlisting Earthlings to keep it from vanishing into a black hole of forgotten dreams.

We’ll be back time to time with important updates!

Thank you for following our adventures in the land of video game making!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611620/a22de51e2e02477b7366d4a2f126016673a61543.jpg[/img]

In case you'd like to stay in touch, please find our social links here:
https://linktr.ee/studiomonoblok


Until next time,
Team Earthlings
